1.2 Import data

Pending

Code 
# Import the data from the sweep package
bike_sales <- bike_sales |>
    mutate(
        order.id = factor(
            x = order.id,
            ordered = TRUE
        ),
        order.line = factor(
            x = order.line,
            ordered = TRUE
        ),
        customer.id = factor(
            x = customer.id,
            ordered = FALSE
        ),
        product.id = factor(
            x = product.id,
            ordered = FALSE
        )
    )

1.5.2.1 Revenue by category secondary

Pending

Code 
bike_sales |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_boxplot(
        aes(
            x = price.ext,
            y = category.secondary
        )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        transform = "log10",
        labels = label_currency()
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Revenue (US Dollars)",
        y = "Category Secondary"
    )

1.6 Questions answered with data

1.6.1 Bikeshop by total revenue

Pending

Code 
revenue_by_bike_shop <- bike_sales |>
    group_by(bikeshop.name) |>
    summarize(total_revenue = sum(price.ext)) |>
    mutate(
        bikeshop.name = fct_reorder(
            .f = bikeshop.name,
            .x = total_revenue
        )
    )

revenue_by_bike_shop |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_col(
        aes(
            x = total_revenue,
            y = bikeshop.name
        )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        labels = label_currency()
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Total revenue (US Dollars)",
        y = "Bike shop"
    )

1.6.2 Category secondary by total revenue

Code 
revenue_by_cat2 <- bike_sales |>
    group_by(category.secondary) |>
    summarize(total_revenue = sum(price.ext)) |>
    mutate(
        category.secondary = fct_reorder(
            .f = category.secondary,
            .x = total_revenue
        )
    )

revenue_by_cat2 |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_col(
        aes(
            x = total_revenue,
            y = category.secondary
        )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        labels = label_currency()
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Total revenue (US Dollars)",
        y = "Category Secondary"
    )
